verdict.rationale: n8n documents a core Webhook node, and a hands-on user reports building 'webhook-initiated tasks' in production. Together these confirm that external HTTP requests can start workflow runs. The pack only carries the docs page title, though, so the details of the story are not shown. Missing for 10: documented custom URL/path configuration, explicit evidence of how the request payload is passed into the workflow run, and HTTP method/auth/response options.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload
